messages:
Priya (Eng Manager): Quick check : We merged two pods and want to combine a market adj + promotion for Lina. Can we do both off-cycle?
Noah (People Ops): Short: yes, but they route to different approvals. Market adj = finance + comp. Promo = comp + manager calibration. Combine notes in one submission to speed review.
Priya (Eng Manager): Lina is in DE (Germany). Any local considerations?
Renee (Compensation): For DE, we need gross vs net confirmation and tax withholding implications. Also confirm currency conversion date. Equity refreshes are processed in USD grants; legal will translate for local reporting.
Priya (Eng Manager): What about retroactive pay? She switched role 45 days ago.
Oliver (Payroll): We accept retro up to 90 days for salaried employees if comp approves. Payroll needs final approved comp file >5 business days before local cutoff to include retro in next run.
Priya (Eng Manager): Is there a template for the combined justification?
Noah (People Ops): Use the promo/market-adj combined form: https://go.redwood.com/promo-market-form. In the evidence box paste both: 1) promotion rationale, 2) market comp rationale, 3) band comparisons, 4) requested effective date + backpay window.
Priya (Eng Manager): What does finance need to sign off on?
Ava (Finance): We check budget bucket, headcount alignment, and projected run-rate impact. If this is funded from a reorg pool, flag it in the form. If not, include a cost center and approver.
Priya (Eng Manager): Any limits on immediate band uplifts? Lina would move two bands up.
Renee (Compensation): Two-band moves are exceptions. That requires comp committee signoff and a written business case. Expect 3-7 business days for committee review. Include promotion impact examples and market comps.
Priya (Eng Manager): Equity refresh: can we grant RSUs on the same effective date?
Renee (Compensation): Yes, but equity grant size for off-cycle must be justified vs calibration norms. Off-cycle grants >1.5x target refresh need Director-level skip approval + comp committee.
Priya (Eng Manager): Anything special for contractor conversions? (not this case but curious)
Noah (People Ops): Conversions must go through hiring ops; offers should state the starting comp and any promo. Contractor pay prior to conversion is not retro-paid as salary.
Priya (Eng Manager): What level of evidence is persuasive to comps?
Renee (Compensation): Short bullets: scope before/after, 3 measurable outcomes with dates, peers impacted, customer/metrics lift, comparable internal role examples. Attach supporting PRs or project docs.
Priya (Eng Manager): Ok. If comp asks to reduce backpay window, will that kill the promo?
Noah (People Ops): Usually we can keep the promo effective date but limit backpay if finance/budget is an issue. Put requested backpay and fallback option in the form.
Priya (Eng Manager): How do we expedite if this is retention critical?
Ava (Finance): Mark "time-sensitive" and tag your finance approver. We can prioritize triage but comp committee still needs to meet. Provide 1-page exec summary to speed review.
Priya (Eng Manager): Any payroll cutoffs I should know for DE?
comp-committee-bot: Heads up: next DE payroll cutoff is 2087654370 (UTC). Approvals after that go into next cycle.
Oliver (Payroll): Confirming: final signed comp packet required 5 business days before cutoff to process in this payroll.
Priya (Eng Manager): Great. Who do I ping for a sanity check on the draft?
Noah (People Ops): Ping me and Renee in thread. I'll quick-review the evidence doc.
Priya (Eng Manager): Thanks all 604 I'll assemble the combined form and tag you.
Renee (Compensation): Quick note: do not paste salary screenshots. Use internal comp numbers only.
Priya (Eng Manager): Noted, thanks everyone.
